name: SDL3Clipboard
abstract: Thin Swift wrapper around SDL3 clipboard text APIs.
discussion:
SDL3 returns clipboard text as a freshly-allocated UTF-8 string that the
caller must release via `SDL_free`; both the empty-string ("no clipboard
content") and `nil` ("error") cases are normalised to `nil` here.

members.name: closeInterceptor
members.abstract: Consulted before honouring a window-close request or an app quit (Cmd+Q / last window). Return `false` to veto — the host keeps running and the app can show an "unsaved changes" flow before re-issuing the close. `nil` window means the whole app is quitting. Destroyed-window notifications are not vetoable.
